throng keeps every project's terminals and editors in one window.

## What throng is for

Read the [Quick start](quick-start.md) first, then [Terminals](terminals.md#open-a-terminal).
Settings are in the [preferences reference](../docs/preferences.md#window.nativeWayland), chords in
[key bindings](../docs/key-bindings.md#view), help is [`help.open`](../docs/key-bindings.md#help.open), and the
whole [preferences reference](../docs/preferences.md) starts with its sections. The
[installation guide](../docs/installation.md) is on GitHub.
